The family, the flat #E4CFAF where the engine ran grad-gold, and the DROP: 10477:5229 writes 0 2px 1px black where textStyle's default is the panel's #1a093a at size/18 with no blur, so TextOptions.shadow takes a spec as well as a boolean and the spec scales with the bar. Vegas fortune HUD, the furthest of the five from the engine on every axis at once. Re-measured 2026-09-17 (wave48-play-slots, 7e1c9b4f) and the wave 46 residual is CLOSED, though not by the thing that was expected to close it. index.html does now link all six display families, and that was necessary and not sufficient: a linked Google Fonts stylesheet DECLARES an @font-face, and the browser fetches the file only when a RENDERED ELEMENT asks for the family. Phaser draws this bar on a canvas, and a canvas pulls no webfont, so the readouts still resolved the stack's next entry on a cold load. slots/engine/fonts.ts now asks document.fonts for the four kind-stack families plus the running skin's face, inside the same Promise.all as the engine's dynamic imports and raced against a 1200ms deadline, BEFORE the game is constructed - a Phaser Text renders once and keeps its bitmap, so a face that lands after a readout is drawn never reaches the player. Nothing blocks on it; a face that misses the window falls through the CSS stack. fonts.test.ts pins both ends, including that index.html links every family the engine names. No browser ran. VEGAS_FORTUNE_SKIN.readoutFace {Sancreek, flat, 16, shadow 0/2/1 #000000}: the family, the fill (flat #E4CFAF where the engine ran grad-gold) and the DROP all move - 10477:5229 writes 0 2px 1px black where textStyle's default is the panel's #1a093a at size/18 with no blur, so TextOptions.shadow takes a spec as well as a boolean and the spec scales with the bar. The one skin where palette.barText and palette.win hold the same value, because the frame writes captions and values in the same cream; the keys stay separate, since on the other four they differ. Sancreek has no numeric fallback that resembles it, so this is the bar the unfetched family showed on most and the one the fix most changes.
